title: Starry Night Farmstead
description: A nocturnal rural landscape featuring a red farmhouse and barn nestled in a vast field of glowing blue and golden wildflowers. The dramatic night sky is filled with a vibrant Milky Way, colorful nebulae, and countless bright stars, framed by an ornate dark wooden frame with purple gem accents.
prompt: A serene rural night scene with a red farmhouse and barn in a misty field of luminous blue and golden wildflowers under a breathtaking starry sky. The vibrant Milky Way and colorful nebulae swirl across the deep purple heavens, with scattered trees and wooden fences in the midground. Painted in a rich, luminous fantasy style with visible brushwork, presented inside an ornate dark wooden frame with purple jewel details.
